interpretation.label: stage2_dv_calibration_banked
interpretation.text: CALIBRATION BANKED: 3 freshly-drawn seeds (5 draws) cleared the inherited training-completion gate, of which 3 were revisit-non-degenerate (both arms >0 total revisits) and used for the range below; 0 were revisit-degenerate and are recorded in per_seed_dv but excluded from the aggregate. decline_rate_gap (A0 minus A1) over non-degenerate pooled seeds: mean=-0.000431244, range=0.00129373. A1 control-arm decline_rate range=0.00127669 -- the statistic ext002_stage2_dv_threshold_feasibility_20260911.md Section 2 recommends deriving a future C1-equivalent bar from. NOT a verdict on EXT-002/ARC-013 -- claim-free, no pre-registered threshold. This pool was NOT gated on 983a's own evidence-run P4 revisit-denominator floor (see per_seed_dv[].clears_legacy_p4_floor), so it may include lower-revisit-volume seeds than a P4-gated evidence run would admit -- read the banked range with that in mind. Governance/queue-experiment should set stage 2's evidence-run threshold from this range, and resolve the feasibility doc's point (b) -- revisit-volume aggregation: min-across-pooled-cells=18 vs median-across-pooled-cells=23.0 over the early-half counts recorded here -- before queuing the full evidence run.

preconditions.name: pooled_seed_count
preconditions.description: number of freshly-drawn seeds clearing the inherited training-completion gate (steps_realized_frac>=0.60, harm_rate_train<=0.35, both arms)

preconditions.name: revisit_population_non_degenerate
preconditions.description: at least one pooled seed has a NON-ZERO TOTAL REVISIT COUNT (n_revisits_early + n_revisits_late) in BOTH arms -- not just a non-zero distinct-erred-key count, which a seed can carry while still generating zero revisits (red-team F2: erred keys and revisits are different quantities; a keys-based test would pass a seed whose DV is nonetheless a structural 0/0)
preconditions.control: pooled seeds surviving the completion gate
